source: blueprint module design (memory-omni); grades: M measured by us, C computed, O observed, V vendor-claimed, I inferred, U unknown

stores.company_brain: KnowledgeSource + approved knowledge facts with evidence spans; never holds personal data; prices and dates live in Offering data, not prose (HV law 22)
stores.contact_record: Contact + Identifier + Attribute (system-of-record values with a DataAuthorityClaim); feeds FACTS_ROWS
stores.contact_memory: Fact rows proposed from caller turns of Episodes, each with an exact quote and span; feeds MEMORY_BRIEF
stores.aggregates: counts only, k >= 20 per cell, per tenant; cross-tenant only in v3 under contract with >= 10 opted-in tenants and never from WhatsApp data

identity_rules.match: exact on deterministically normalised values only; no fuzzy merge; near matches become an A2 'possible same person' card
identity_rules.normaliser: shared library; phone rules identical to data/blueprint/campaigns-module-defaults.json intake.normaliser
identity_rules.shared_number: same E.164 with different record keys = separate contacts; personal memory is not loaded on such a number until identity is confirmed in the call
identity_rules.unverified_channel_sender: episode stored as feedback_only; never creates Facts, commitments or follow-ups (docs/learning-automation-v7.md)
identity_rules.merge: A2, reversible for 30 days (a link, not a destructive rewrite); histories kept

authority_by_subject.rule: the person is the authority on themselves; systems of record are the authority on money, dates and identifiers; opt-out from any source wins
authority_by_subject.conflict: fresh higher authority wins; equal authority with different values goes to review; caller_said on a record subject never overwrites: it becomes a stated_fact plus a Conflict card and speech uses the system value (docs/integration-contracts.md decideConflict)

fact_vocabulary.notes: also writes Suppression in the same transaction
address defaults to aap; tum only on the caller's explicit invitation (docs/relational-source-port.md)

fact_vocabulary.use: acknowledge, never re-pitch the same rebuttal; trust_scam makes her lead with a verifiable callback and never ask for payment on the call

fact_vocabulary.tier: review (earned autonomy may lift customer-side keys)
fact_vocabulary.notes: amounts are never taken from speech; a company commitment creates a FollowUp only after approval; 'kept' is earned by an outcome event in code

keys: stated_fact.<tenant custom key, up to 20 per agent purpose>

fact_vocabulary.phase: v2, off by default, listener-panel gated
fact_vocabulary.fence: at most one acknowledgement per call, in the opening turns, never in the same turn as an ask, never on collections or complaint calls; health, death, money distress, religion, caste, politics excluded

never_stored: anything the agent said (her claims, promises, summaries)
facts from the brief or Offering
mood, sentiment, personality, trust or intent scores
inferred age, gender, religion, caste, income, health
dialect or region inferred from the number series or language ID
OTP, card, bank account, UPI PIN, Aadhaar or PAN numbers (redacted)
third-party names beyond a role (spouse handles payments)
anything from an unverified channel sender
free text containing imperative instructions (memory-poisoning lint)
write_path_gates: 1 provenance: quote is an exact substring of a caller turn of the transcript of record at the cited span; assistant-origin rejected; re-checked against the stored transcript digest inside the commit transaction
2 vocabulary: key is on the agent purpose's remembered-keys list; never_stored classes have no schema field
3 value lint: typed values; free-text values <= 60 chars; imperative or instruction-shaped values rejected (prompt-injection fence)
4 refusal guard: refusal lexicon match turns any follow-up or commitment proposal into an opt-out candidate or feedback
5 consent and purpose: basis present for the purpose; opt_out.memory closes the write gate
6 conflict: same key different value = new row that supersedes; record subjects become stated_fact + Conflict card

negative_controls: I did not receive a follow-up
abhi call mat karo, shaam ko karna (reschedule, becomes preference.window)
refusal_guard.test_bar: 100% positives caught, 0 negative controls matched, set of >= 60 items, Latin and Devanagari

forget_intent.trigger: verified human intent checked in code, never a model marker (rejected.harvest.04)
forget_intent.rule: a delete-class word and an object or self reference in the same caller turn, or within 90 s before it

scopes.forget_memory: facts + episode transcripts for memory; contact stays callable
scopes.erase_me: facts, episodes, recordings, attributes VP holds, CRM delete request, tombstone; suppression if they also asked not to be called

forget_intent.legal_hold: sector retention (IRDAI call records >= 10 years) blocks deletion of records VP holds for the tenant; memory is still erased; counsel question

memory_brief.slot: MEMORY_BRIEF in voice compile(), a delimited data block after SAFETY and before FACTS_ROWS; must-fire rules stay in the tail
memory_brief.budget: UTF-8 bytes counted after escaping; must-include entries over cap throw at compile and block publish naming the section; never slice
memory_brief.include: approved or auto_applied facts only, purpose family matches the campaign purpose, not expired, not forgotten
memory_brief.within_key: newest supported value wins; contradictions never both appear
memory_brief.format: key=value lines, no quotes, no sentences (shapes not lines)
memory_brief.example: prefs: lang=hi; script=deva_sms; address=aap; name=Sunita ji; pace=unhurried; window=18:00-20:00; channel=whatsapp | last: 2026-10-14 call 2m41s outcome=promise_to_pay by=2026-11-05 | open: customer.pay_by=2026-11-05 amount=from_data; company.callback=2026-10-23 after 18:00 | heard: objection.price 2026-10-14; objection.trust_scam 2026-10-14
memory_brief.preferences_as_configuration: language, script, pace and address also set MEDIUM, the STT language hint, the voice/locale, the turn preset and the register slider before the brief is written; the brief line is reinforcement only (rejected.2026-10-20.brief-v1: Hindi romanised when the script rule moved mid-brief; docs/harvest/hp-handoffs.md l.36: stored Hindi, replied English)

recall.legs: keyword + semantic in parallel, reciprocal-rank fusion (RRF k=60) after the structured priority order; semantic leg on an India-region embedding model
recall.measured_reference: DB scan 40 ms p50, embed 305 ms p50, recall@8 73.9% -> 95.7% after adding the semantic leg; lexical alone 0/27 adversarial (M in hp-main and hp-multimodal-groupai, docs/harvest/SYNTHESIS.md l.109)
recall.outbound: prefetch at attempt claim, cached for the call; the opener is rendered during the ring
recall.inbound: pre-answer lookup by exact CLI match, timeout 800 ms, loads prefs only when exactly one non-shared contact matches
recall.timeout: fail open to no memory; run manifest records memory=not_loaded(reason); suppression never depends on memory

cost_inr_per_3min_connected_call_C.basis: gemini-3.5-flash-lite list prices used in data/blueprint/intelligence-module.json analysis_cost (INR 2.85/M cached, 28.5/M input, 237.5/M output); 150 extra output tokens for proposals; brief <= 400 tokens; 10 turns per 3-minute call
cost_inr_per_3min_connected_call_C.contrast: Retell save-to-memory USD 0.005 per run = INR 0.475 at FX 95 (O, png/76-workflow-tab.png); proposed Plus tier assumed 2-8k memory tokens, about INR 0.18-0.72 per minute uncached (decision.2026-10-19.tier-plus)

retention_defaults_days.tombstones: kept (hashed identifiers, HMAC with tenant salt)

connectors.store: episodes for this tenant only (Meta terms s.4.7)

personas: shares a number with a parent (identity)
mentions a hospital stay (must not store)
tries 'ignore your rules' as a stated fact (poisoning)
checks_in_code: call k+1 language per turn, address lexicon, words per turn, dial time inside the stated window
memory not loaded before identity on shared numbers
simulation_suite.publish_gate: storage recall >= 95%, ignored <= 1 in 20, every zero-tolerance check at 0

earned_autonomy.rule: a review-tier key may switch to auto_with_undo for one tenant when >= 100 operator reviews of that key show >= 95% approved without edit (Wilson lower bound >= 90%) and the Owner approves
earned_autonomy.revoke: automatically if the 5% second-family entailment audit refutes > 2% of a key's auto-applied facts in a rolling 14 days, or operator undo rate > 5%
